jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

Joining Bien’ici means becoming part of a disruptive force in the real estate sector. Founded in 2015, Bien’ici is revolutionizing property search and aims to become the leading real estate portal in France. Our mission is straightforward: to facilitate meaningful connections around real estate projects between private individuals and professionals by providing a simplified, immersive, and personalized experience that helps users envision their future daily lives. Leveraging our unique technology and exclusive features, we challenge the industry status quo. With over 190 million annual visits, we have established ourselves as the second most visited specialized real estate portal in France. Our entire team is fully committed to achieving this ambitious goal and accelerating our growth.

About The Role

We are currently seeking a Data Engineer to join our Technical Department. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of our Data infrastructure. You will manage the collection, transformation, quality assurance, and availability of data to provide reliable metrics to various business teams. Your key responsibilities will include managing and developing the Data stack, including the Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and Data Marts; overseeing data flow processes such as collection, transformation, and validation; and ensuring the maintenance and reliability of data systems by identifying, diagnosing, and resolving bugs and anomalies.

Additionally, you will guarantee the quality and availability of data by ensuring the accuracy of KPIs and the feeding of internal dashboards across departments such as Market, Commerce, Marketing, and Product. You will also be tasked with automating and optimizing existing data processes and developing new use cases by implementing monitoring and alerting solutions. Supporting the Data teams and end-users in leveraging transformed data through Tableau visualization tools will also be part of your role. The primary technologies you will work with include DBT for data transformation and continuous integration, and Tableau for data visualization.

Qualifications

Master’s degree (Bac +5) from a business school, university, or engineering school
Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer
Experience working with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure
Proven expertise in designing robust and high-performance data pipelines
Curiosity and a pedagogical approach to knowledge sharing
Strong analytical skills with a synthetic and rigorous mindset
Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative team spirit

Bonus Qualities That We Appreciate

A fondness for chocolate
A good sense of humor

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain the Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and Data Marts infrastructure
Manage data flows including collection, transformation, qualification, and validation of data
Identify, diagnose, and resolve bugs and anomalies related to data
Ensure the quality and availability of data by maintaining reliable KPIs and supporting internal dashboards for various business units
Automate and optimize existing data processes related to collection, transformation, and reporting
Develop new use cases by implementing monitoring and alerting solutions
Support Data teams and users in utilizing transformed data through Tableau visualization
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and deliver actionable insights

Benefits

Comprehensive top-tier health insurance coverage
Time Savings Account (Compte Épargne Temps) to manage work-life balance
Meal vouchers (Tickets restaurant)
Comprehensive onboarding training covering all fundamentals to ensure your success and integration

Equal Opportunity

Bien’ici is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or religion. We believe diversity drives innovation and are dedicated to fostering a culture of respect and equality.

Associate

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Technology, Information and Internet

jobs.title: Cloud Data Engineer AWS / Streaming temps réel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Vos missions

Concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture de streaming pour la collecte, le traitement et l'analyse des données
Développer des pipelines de traitement temps réel et batch avec Apache Flink, Apache Spark et Apache Iceberg
Déployer les pipelines d'ingestion et de traitement en CI/CD et Infrastructure as Code, pour les environnements batch et streaming
Participer à la migration et au refactoring de l'architecture historique vers AWS (Move to Cloud, ETL/ELT, batch et streaming)
Contribuer à l'implémentation d'algorithmes de maintenance prédictive et de routage
Industrialiser et exposer des modèles de Machine Learning sous forme d'API, en lien avec les équipes data science
Assurer le monitoring, la fiabilité et la performance des traitements en production

Environnement technique

Streaming et traitement : Apache Flink, Apache Kafka (MSK), Kinesis, Apache Spark, Apache Iceberg
Orchestration : Apache Airflow (MWAA)
Cloud AWS : S3, Lambda, EKS, ECS, EC2, ECR, IAM, IoT Core
IoT : MQTT, données capteurs remontées par satellite
Data warehouse : Snowflake
DevOps / IaC : Terraform, Docker, CI/CD
Langages : Python, SQL

Profil recherché

Formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou master) en informatique, data ou télécommunications
Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en data engineering, dont une part significative sur AWS
Expérience solide des architectures streaming à forte volumétrie (Flink, Kafka ou Kinesis)
Maîtrise de Terraform et des pratiques CI/CD appliquées aux pipelines de données
Une expérience d'industrialisation de modèles ML (MLOps, mise en API, monitoring) est un vrai plus
Une connaissance des données IoT ou industrielles (maintenance prédictive, capteurs) est appréciée
Une certification AWS (Solutions Architect, Data Engineer) est un atout
Anglais professionnel

Savoir-être

Autonomie et sens des responsabilités sur des systèmes critiques en production
Capacité à dialoguer avec les équipes métier pour traduire leurs besoins en solutions techniques
Rigueur, goût de la performance et de la qualité de la donnée
Esprit d'équipe et envie de partager ses pratiques

Informations pratiques

Contrat : CDI chez Visian Azur
Lieu : Marseille, présence régulière sur le site du client
Démarrage : à définir ensemble
Rémunération : selon profil et expérience

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time
